Membranous_Skin_Wings.description: Beneath the moonlit canopy, the creature's membranous wings stretch taut, a living shadow that whispers through the night air, its bat-like form granting it unparalleled maneuverability and the eerie ability to glide silently, unseen by even the most watchful eyes.

Leathery_Great_Wings.description: These immense, leathery wings, reminiscent of ancient reptilian dragons, unfurl with a thunderous crackle, capable of propelling their bearer through the skies with unmatched speed and grace, while the sheer presence of these wings can instill fear and awe in any who lay eyes upon them.

Gossamer_Insectoid_Wings.description: Gossamer_Insectoid_Wings are delicate, butterfly-like appendages that shimmer with an ethereal glow, allowing their bearers to soar through the air with grace and hover mid-flight, granting them an otherworldly agility enhanced by a speed bonus of 30.
